text:
maria: Quick sync — pre-merge CI sweep for release/v2.5.x and main. Cutoff is ~8h from now, please hold non-critical merges. Can folks confirm a green sweep and any version-bump/changelog work? https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/3456 :hourglass:

sam: On it, kicking off the green-sweep job now: `./scripts/green-sweep.sh release/v2.5.x`

deploy-bot: CI job queued: #4567 · estimated run time 22m · triggered by sam

kai: Noticed one intermittent in integration: `TestModelCache/stress` failing locally. I'll try to reproduce and push a fix to fix/cache-flaky if confirmed.

jen: Heads up — we still need the changelog blurb for the tokenizer tweak from @maria. Can you add before merge?

maria: Yep — will add changelog and bump version (2.5.0-rc3) in pkg/version.go in a minute.

ashley: Reminder: do not merge any non-security PRs after cutoff (6h left). If something is urgent, ping here and tag me or @sam.

sam: CI green for release/v2.5.x — job #4567 passed most suites. Two tests marked intermittent flagged as failing, marking as flaky/quarantine and re-running them: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/4567/artifacts

kai: Which tests exactly? Can you paste the failing log lines?

sam: ```
--- FAIL: TestModelCache/stress (0.67s)
    cache_test.go:212: expected entry sizes to match; got 128 vs 64
--- FAIL: TestReranker/oom-iteration (12.34s)
    reranker_test.go:88: OOM occurred on CI agent; locally not repro
```

jen: I'll prep the changelog PR once maria's commit lands — easier to cherry-pick to release branch.

maria: Done — commit 9f3a1b2: bumped version to 2.5.0-rc3 and added changelog entry for tokenizer change.

ashley: Thanks. Can we do a quick canary rollout after merge for the tokenizer-only change? Low-risk route to prod.

deploy-bot: Canary job started: build 3456-canary · region us-west-2 · status: running

sam: If the canary times out or latencies spike, routing will fall back to main-legacy model per policy (auto-fallback enabled). I'll keep an eye on traces.

kai: I'll monitor the flaky-dashboard and add flakiness tags to the two failing tests, plus open a flaky-test ticket for triage.

jen: All good from my side — once the green artifacts are uploaded and changelog is in release notes, we can merge.

maria: Planning to merge in ~30m unless objections.

sam: No objections, going to protect the branch until release completes :lock:

ashley: Thanks team — excellent coordination. If anything comes up, ping here and we'll pause the rollout. :thumbsup:
